states.label: File operation failed; index remains safe
Writer owns lock and reads index

rules.name: Spec
rules.says: Starting from a valid bounded library fixture, every observed step follows the library safety model.

rules.name: ListedItemsHaveBytes
rules.says: Every item in the published index has a complete blob, including during operations and after a file operation fails.

rules.name: ReadFailurePreservesItems
rules.says: An index read failure preserves every previously listed item through the next save in the recovery scenario.

rules.name: UniqueKindName
rules.says: The index contains at most one item with any given kind and name.

rules.name: WithinCap
rules.says: The index never exceeds its item cap.

rules.name: SaveRetainsOtherItems
rules.says: Publishing a save preserves every other item except the oldest entries that must be trimmed to make room.

rules.name: SuccessfulSaveIsFirst
rules.says: At a successful save response, the saved item is first in the index.

rules.name: SuccessfulSaveHasGivenBytes
rules.says: At a successful save response, the saved item's blob contains exactly the supplied bytes.

rules.name: SuccessfulDeleteRemovesItem
rules.says: At a successful delete response, the selected item is absent from the index, or the index is empty for delete-all.

rules.name: OneWriter
rules.says: Only the current lock owner can be executing an index mutation, and at most one request executes one at a time.

rules.name: TypeOK
rules.says: All state has the declared bounded types, with two tracked kinds and names, two exposed capacity slots beside 58 fixed background entries, two requests and at most one failed file operation.

rules.name: SaveSucceeds
rules.says: A save can succeed.

rules.name: UpsertSucceeds
rules.says: Saving an existing kind and name can successfully replace its previous item.

rules.name: TrimSucceeds
rules.says: Saving into a full library can succeed while trimming the oldest item.

rules.name: DeleteOneSucceeds
rules.says: Deleting one item can succeed while preserving another item.

rules.name: DeleteAllSucceeds
rules.says: Deleting all items can successfully empty the index.

rules.name: ConcurrentSavesSurvive
rules.says: Two queued saves of different keys can both succeed and remain listed.

rules.name: ReadErrorThenSaveSucceeds
rules.says: After one save fails to read the index, the next queued save can succeed and retain the previously listed item.

rules.name: WriteErrorThenSaveSucceeds
rules.says: After a blob write fails, the promise chain can run the next queued save successfully.

rules.name: RenameFailureKeepsIndex
rules.says: An index rename can fail while leaving the previously published index intact.

rules.name: RemovalFailureKeepsIndexSafe
rules.says: Removing an obsolete blob can fail while the published index remains valid.

rules.name: RemoveBeforePublishing
rules.says: An upsert, trim or delete removes a blob while the published index still lists it.

rules.name: DiscardIndexOnReadError
rules.says: A save treats an index read error as an empty library and publishes a replacement index that forgets existing items.

rules.name: PublishStaleSave
rules.says: A concurrent save publishes a stale snapshot that drops the previous save's unrelated item.

rules.name: WriteWrongBytes
rules.says: A save writes different bytes from those supplied and still reports success.
